description: Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority -  The Tourism (Registration of Ayurvedic Hotel) Regulation No. 2. of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005, specifically the "Tourism (Registration of Ayurvedic Hotel) Regulations No. 2 of 2019." It establishes legal requirements for registering and licensing Ayurvedic Hotels as tourist enterprises, including application procedures, fees, standards, and compliance mechanisms. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks under an existing Act of Parliament.
